extraction.notes: Q4 2022 (three months ended Dec 31, 2022) reconciliation from Note 1 on printed page 10. BRT reports no core FFO metric. Starting line is GAAP net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(4,219)K. FFO of 7,594 and AFFO of 6,994 foot correctly. Diluted share count 18,938,807 is printed in full on page 11, so it is entered as 18,938.807 thousand; 7,594/18,938.8 = 0.40 and 6,994/18,938.8 = 0.37, both matching reported per-share figures. Zero-valued lines (dashes in the Q4 2022 column) are included with amount 0. Gain on insurance recovery is categorized as casualty. Recurring capex: AFFO does not deduct recurring capex. The only recurring capex figure is on the Value-Add Program and Capital Expenditures page (printed page 10, seq 28), BRT share $5,280,000 for the twelve months ended Dec 31, 2022. No quarterly recurring capex figure is disclosed, so basis is annual.
